senses.gloss:
r. 1st cl. (शशति)
To jump, to leap, to move by springing or leaping.

m. (-शः)
1 A hare or rabbit.
2 The Lodh tree, (Symplocos racemosa.)
3 Gum myrrh.
4 A man of mild and virtuous character, but uxorious^1 and woman-led, one of the four characters in which men are classed by erotic writers.
5 The spots on the moon, supposed to resemble the figure of a hare.
E.
शश to go by leaps or jumps, aff. अच.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

r. 1st cl. (-शषति)
To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.

(इ) and the preposition आङ् always prefixed आशसि r. 1st cl. (आशंसते)
1 To bless, to wish good to, to confer a benediction.
2 To wish, to desire.
3 To speak.
(उ) शसु r. 1st cl. (शसति)
To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.
With अभि,
To intreat.

(उ,) शासु r. 2nd cl. (शास्ति)
1 To instruct, to inform.
2 To order, to direct, to enact.
3 To rule, to govern.
(शास्ते)
1 To wish or desire:
with आङ् prefixed,
r. 1st cl. (आशासते) r. 2nd cl. (आशास्ते)
To wish well to, to bless.

r. 2nd cl. (सस्ति)
To sleep.

r. 2nd cl. (सलि)
To sleep; also षस.

m. (-कः)
A hare.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्)
Leaping, jumping.
E.
शश to leap, शतृ aff.

m. (-रः)
The moon.
E.
शश a hare, and धर having; either as an emblem on his banners, or fancifully, as the spots on the moon's face.

n. (-कं)
A mark or scratch of the finger nail.
E.
शश a hare, प्लुतक jumping.

m. (-न्दुः)
1 VIṢṆU, or KṚṢṆA.
2 A sovereign.
3 The moon.
E.
शश a bare, and बिन्दु a spot.

m. (-भृत्)
The moon.
E.
शश a hare, and भृत् who cherishes: see शशधर.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं)
As large as or of the size of a hare.
E.
शश, and मात्रच् aff.

m. (-नः)
The moon.
E.
शश, and लाञ्छन mark.

n. (-म)
The skin of the hare or rabbit.
E.
शश a hare or rabbit, and लोमन् hair.

n. (-णं)
The horn of a hare; any thing improbable or extraordinary.
E.
शश, and विषाण a horn.

f. (-ली)
The Doab, the country between the Ganges and Yamunā rivers.
E.
शश a hare, स्थल place, site.

m. (-ङ्कः)
The moon.
E.
शश a hare, and अङ्क a mark or spot.

mfn. (-ङ्कः-ङ्का-ङ्कं)
Fearful, doubtful.
E.
स with, शङ्का fear.

f. (-खा)
A digit of the moon.
E.
शशाङ्क, and लेखा a streak.

m. (-नः)
A hawk or falcon.
E.
शश a hare or rabbit, and अदन what eats.

m. (-वः)
A sovereign, named also रन्तिदेव.

m. (-शी)
1 The moon.
2 The emblem of one of the Jinas.
E.
शश a hare, इनि aff.

m. (-दः)
A moon-beam.
E.
शशि, and पाद a ray; also similar compounds, as शशिकर, शशिकिरण, शशिमयूख, शशिरश्मि, &c.

n. (-भं)
The white esculent water-lily.
f. (-भा)
Moonlight.
E.
शशि the moon, and प्रभ shining, (blossoming,) or प्रभा lustre, light.

f. (-खा)
1 A digit of the moon.
2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.)
3 A metre, a variety of the line of the Atijagatī stanza of thirteen syllables, or of the Atisaceari of fifteen syllables.
E.
शशि the moon, and लेखा a line or mark.

f. (-ना)
1 A woman with a face like the moon.
2 A species of the Gāyatrī metre.
E.
शशि, and वदन face.

m. (-रः)
1 ŚIVA.
2 One of the Jaina pontiffs.
E.
शशि the moon, and शेखर a crest.

m. (-शः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
शशि, and ईश lord.

n. (-र्णं)
The hair of the hare or rabbit.
E.
शश a hare, &c., and ऊर्णा wool.

ind.
Again and again, frequently, repeatedly, perpetually.
E.
शश to go by jumps, वति aff.

m. (-लः)
A plant, (Galedupa arborea, Rox.)
f. (-ली)
1 The outer ear or opening of the external auditory passage.
2 Rice or barley water, &c.
3 A sort of pie.

mfn. (-लः-ली-लं)
Eating flesh or fish.
E.
शुष्कुली flesh, अण् aff. form irr.: see शौष्कुल.

n. (-ष्पं)
1 Young grass.
2 Loss of intellect or confidence.
E.
शस to hurt, Uṇādi aff. प, and स changed to ष; also शस्य.

n. (-स्पं)
1 Young grass.
2 Loss of confidence or understanding.
E.
शस to injure, प aff., and the sibilant unchanged.

n. (-नं)
Immolation, offering an animal in sacrifice.
E.
शस to hurt, aff. ल्युट्; also शमन.

n. (-नं)
1 An order, an edict, a command.
2 A royal grant of land or of privileges, a charter, &c. usually inscribed on stone or copper.
3 A writing, a deed, a written contract or agreement.
4 A Śāstra or scripture.
5 Devotion, or devotional tranquillity, the government of the passions.
6 Governing, ruling, government.
E.
शास to order or direct, aff. ल्युट.

n. (-नं)
Immolation, offering a living victim.
E.
सस to sleep, &c., aff. ल्युट्; also शसन and शमन.

(इ) शस्ति r. 2nd cl. (शंस्ति)
To sleep, (peculiar to the Vedas.)

mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं)
1 Happy, well, right.
2 Praised, eulogised.
3 Best, excellent.
n. (-स्तं)
1 Happiness, excellence.
2 The body.
E.
शस to bless, aff. क्त.

n. (-कं)
A defence for the finger of an archer.
E.
कन् added to the last.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Having much or beautiful hair.
E.
शस्त excellent, केश hair, कन् aff.

n. (-स्त्रं)
1 A weapon in general.
2 Iron.
3 Steel.
m. (-स्त्रः)
A sword, a scymitar.
f. (-स्री)
A knife.
E.
शस to hurt, aff. ष्ट्रन.

n. (-स्त्रं)
1 An order or command.
2 Scripture, science, institutes of religion, law or letters, especially considered as of divine origin or authority: used singly, it implies works of literature or science in general, and it is therefore customarily connected with some other word to limit its application, as the Vedānta Śāstras, or treatises of philosophical theology; the Dharma Śāstras, books of law, &c.: it is also applied to less important branches of knowledge, as the Kāvya Śāstras, or poetical works; Śilpi Śāstras, works on the mechanical arts; and Kāma Śāstras, or erotic^1 compositions; in the singular number it is also used comprehensively to signify the body of all that has been written on the subject, as Dharma Śāstra, the institutes or code of law; Kāvya Śāstra, poetry; Alaṅkāra Śāstra, rhetoric, &c.
3 A book in general.
E.
शास to govern or teach, aff. ष्ट्रन्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-कं)
1 Iron.
2 Steel.
E.
शस्त्र a weapon, and कन् aff.

m. (-रः)
An armourer.
E.
शस्त्र, and कार who makes.

m. (-हः)
Taking arms.
E.
शस्त्र, and ग्रह taking.

m. (-ही)
A man armed.
E.
शस्त्र, and ग्राहिन् who takes

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Clanging.
E.
शस्त्र, and धुष्ट sounded, कर what makes.

n. (-लं)
A quantity of weapons.
E.
शस्त्र, and जाल a heap.

m. (-वी)
A soldier by profession.
E.
शस्त्र a weapon, and जीविन् who lives by.

m. (-गः)
Throwing away a weapon.
E.
शस्त्र, and त्याग abandoning.

m. (-रः)
An armed man or soldier.
E.
शस्त्र, and धर who has.

mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि)
A warrior armed, having weapons in the hand.
E.
शस्र, and पाणि the hand.

m. (-तः)
The stroke of a weapon.
E.
शस्र, and पात falling.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Purified by arms, absolved from guilt by dying in the field of battle.
E.
शस्र, and पूत purified.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Taking arms.
E.
शस्र, and प्रहरण taking.

m. (-भृत्)
An armed man, a soldier.
E.
शस्र a weapon, and भृत् having.

m. (-र्जः)
An armourer.
E.
शस्र a weapon, and भाज cleaning.

m. (-त्तिः)
A soldier, a man at arms.
E.
शस्र, and वृत्ति profession.

f. (-तिः)
1 A quantity or number of weapons.
2 An arsenal, an armoury.
E.
शस्र, and संहति assemblage.

n. (-हं)
1 A quantity or number of weapons.
2 An arsenal, an armoury.
E.
शस्र, and ममूह a heap.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Struck or killed by a weapon.
E.
शस्र, and हत hurt.

m. (-स्तः)
A man carrying arms.
E.
शस्र a weapon, and हस्त the hand.

m. (-वः)
A soldier.
E.
शस्त्र a weapon, and आजीव who lives by.

m. (-सः)
Military exercise or practice.
E.
शस्त्र a weapon, and अभ्यास practice.

n. (-स्त्रं)
Use of weapons.
E.
शस्त्र, and अस्त्र a weapon, or means of offence or defence.

m. (-भृत्)
A soldier, a warrior.
E.
शस्त्रास्त्र, and भृत who has.

n. (-त्त्वं)
The military profession, the use of arms.
E.
शस्त्रास्त्रभृत्, and त्व aff.

mfn. (-स्त्री-स्त्रिणी-स्त्रि)
Armed, having weapons.
E.
शस्त्र, and इनि aff.

m. (-स्त्री)
A Paṇḍita, a teacher of holy science, or one skilled in it.
E.
शास्त्र as above, and इनि aff.

n. (-नं)
Raising a weapon, (as to strike.)
E.
शस्त्र, and उत्थापन taking up.

m. (-मः)
Lifting up a weapon, (as to strike.)
E.
शस्त्र, and उद्यम lifting up.

m. (-वी)
A soldier, a man at arms.
E.
शस्त्र, and उपजीविन् living by.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
1 Excellent, best.
2 To be hurt or injured.
3 Desirable, to be wished.
n. (-स्यं)
1 Fruit.
2 Corn, grain in general.
3 Good quality, merit.
E.
शस to hurt, aff. यत्; or शसि to wish, क्यप् aff.

mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं)
1 To be regulated or ordained, to be enforced, to be provided for by any act of government or judicature.
2 Punishable, deserving punishment.
E.
शास to govern, aff. यत्.

n. (-स्यं)
1 Fruit.
2 Corn, grain.
3 A weapon.
4 A quality, an excellence.
E.
सस to sleep, य Uṇādi aff.; also शस्य, &c.

n. (-त्रं)
A corn field.
E.
शस्य, and क्षेत्र a field.

m. (-शी)
A timber tree, commonly Toon, (Cedrela tunna.)
E.
शस्य fruit, and ध्वंसिन् injurious.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Graminivorous.
E.
शस्य, and भक्षक what eats.

n. (-णं)
Feeding upon grain.
E.
शस्य, and भक्षण eating.

f. (-री)
1 The ear or spike of corn.
2 The fruit stalk.
E.
शस्य, and मञ्जरी pedicle.

m. (-कः)
A watchman over a field of corn.
E.
शस्य, and रक्षक who protects.

n. (-कं)
The beard of corn.
E.
शस्य corn, and शूक beard.

m. (-रः)
The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.)
E.
शस्य fruit, and सम्बर surrounding.

m. (-रुः)
A small variety of the Mimosa suma.

mfn. (-तः-ती-तं)
Eternal, perpetual.
m. (-तः)
1 A name of VYĀSA.
2 ŚIVA.
3 The sun.
n. (-तं)
Heaven, ether.
f. (-ती)
The earth.
E.
शश्वत् perpetually, अण् aff.

n. (-कं)
A multitude of pies.
E.
शष्कुली a sort of pie, ठक् aff.

n. (-त्रं)
A plate of copper, a stone or sheet of paper, &c. on which an edict or grant is inscribed.
E.
शासन, and पत्र leaf.

m. (-रः)
A royal messenger, one bearing an edict or grant.
E.
शासन an edict, and हर who takes.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be governed or directed.
E.
शास to rule, अनीयर् aff.; also शासितव्य and शास्य.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Governed, ruled.
E.
शास to rule, aff. क्त.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Ordering, commanding, a governor or commander.
E.
शास to order, तृच् aff. with इट् augment.

f. (-स्तिः)
1 A command, an order.
2 Governing, ruling, ordering.
3 A sceptre.
4 Correction, punishment.
E.
शास to govern, aff. क्तिन् or ति Uṇādi aff.

r. 2nd cl. (सस्ति)
To sleep, (this is not universally considered to be a root.)

mfn. (-स्ता-स्ती-स्तृ)
1 A ruler, one who rules or governs.
2 A teacher, teaching, instructing.
m. (-स्ता)
A Buddha or Jina, or the deified teacher of one or both those sects.
E.
शास to govern, &c. aff. तृच्, and the augment omitted.

m. (-कृत्)
1 A Ṛṣi, a holy personage of divine character.
2 An author in general.
E.
शास्त्र a Śāstra or scripture, &c., and कृत् the author; the principal compositions in Hindu religion, law, and literature, being attributed to sanctified and superhuman personages.

m. (-ण्डः)
A general and superficial scholar.

n. (-क्षुः)
Grammar.
E.
शास्त्र science, and चक्षुस् the eye.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Acquainted with the Śāstras, skilled in the knowledge of law and religion especially.
E.
शास्त्र a sacred work, and ज्ञ who knows.

f. (-ता)
Knowledge of the Śāstras.
E.
शास्त्रज्ञ, and तल् aff.; also शास्त्रज्ञत्वं.

n. (-नं)
Knowledge derived from the study of sacred works.
E.
शास्त्र, and ज्ञान knowledge.

n. (-त्त्वं)
The truth or true knowledge taught in sacred works.
E.
शास्त्र, and तत्त्व truth.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Understanding the works of sacred science.
m. (-ज्ञः)
An astrologer, an astronomer.
E.
शास्त्र sacred or astronomical science, तत्त्व the truth, and ज्ञ who knows.

ind.
After or according to the Śāstras.
E.
शास्त्र, and तसि aff.

mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि)
Skilled in sacred science.
E.
शास्त्र Śāstra, and दर्शिन् who inspects.

f. (-न्दा)
Revilling or denying the authority of sacred works.
E.
शास्त्र, and निन्दा reviling.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 The subject of the Śāstras.
2 Discussing works of sacred literature.
E.
शास्त्र, and प्रसङ्ग attaching to.

ind.
Conformably or according to written authority.
E.
शास्त्र and वति aff.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Having or following sacred institutes, &c.
E.
शास्त्र, and मतुप् aff.

mfn. (-विट्)
Understanding or conversant with the scriptures, skilled in sacred science.
E.
शास्त्र a Śāstra, and विट् who knows.

n. (-नं)
Sacred ritual, ceremonial precept.
E.
शास्त्र, and विधान direction; also शास्त्रविधि.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Contrary to law or religion, illegal, forbidden.
E.
शास्त्र a Śāstra, and विप्रतिषिद्ध prohibited.

n. (-धं)
Any act contrary to the legal and religious institutes of the Hindus.
E.
शास्त्र an institute, and वि and प्रति contra-indicative prefixes before षिद्ध to accomplish, aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Contrary to law or religion.
E.
शास्त्र, and विरुद्ध opposed to.

m. (-धः)
1 Opposition or deviation from sacred authority.
2 Contradiction or incompatibility of different systems.
E.
शास्त्र, and विरोध contrariety.

plu. m. (-नः)
The people of Kashmir.
E.
शास्त्र a treatise, and शिल्पिन an artificer.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Established or proved by sacred institutes or divine works.
E.
शास्त्र, and सिद्ध established.

m. (-णः)
1 Versed in the scriptures, well read in the works of sacred science, a Paṇḍita.
2 A follower of the Vedas, one whose conduct is regulated by their precepts.
E.
शास्त्र a sacred treatise, and आचरण who goes through or studies.

m. (-मः)
Behaving ill or immorally, transgressing, acting contrary to the Śāstras.
E.
शास्त्र, and अतिक्रम surpassing.

n. (-नं)
Following the Śāstras, conforming to the law or ritual, &c.
E.
शास्त्र, and अनुष्ठान conforming.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Who or what obeys or follows sacred institutes, &c.
2 Established or authorised by the Śāstras.
E.
शास्त्र, and अनुष्ठित following.

m. (-रः)
Conformity to sacred ordinances.
E.
शास्त्र, and अनुसार following.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Learned, versed in the Śāstras.
E.
शास्त्र, and अभिज्ञ who knows.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Scriptural, authorised by or conformable to sacred institutes.
E.
शास्त्र, and छ aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
Said or declared in a work of sacred authority.
E.
शास्त्र, and उक्त said.

mfn. plu. only (षट् or षड्)
Six.

f. (-ष्ठिः)
Sixty.
E.
षष् six, डटि aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Bought with sixty.
mf. (-कः-का)
A kind of rice of quick growth.
E.
षष् six, (days,) ठन् aff. or षष्ठि sixty, and कन् added.

mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं)
Fit for rice of quick growth, (a field, &c.)
E.
षष्टिक, and यन् aff.

mfn. (-मः-मी-मं)
Sixtieth.
E.
षष्टि sixty, and तमट् aff.

ind.
In sixty ways.
E.
षष्टि sixty, and धा aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं)
Sixth.
f. (-ष्ठी)
1 DURGĀ.
2 The sixth day of the lunar fortnight.
E.
षष् six, डटि aff., and थुक् augment.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठी-ष्ठं)
Sixth.
E.
षष्ठ the same, and अञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Sixth.
E.
कन् added to the last.

n. (-न्नं)
A sixth meal, i. e. one in three days.
E.
षष्ठ, and अन्न food.

n. (-लं)
The taking of food once in three days, as an act of penance.
E.
षष्ठान्न, and काल time; also with कन् added, षष्ठान्नकालकं.

f. (-ता)
Eating once in three days, on the evening of the third day.
E.
षष्ठान्नकाल, and तल् aff.

mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि)
Being or having the sixth (year, &c.)
E.
षष्ठ, and इनि poss. aff.

m. (-त्तः)
An elephant.
E.
षष्ठि sixth, (year,) and मत्त furious.

m. (-नः)
1 An elephant.
